name: alchemyagent
description: AI search toolkit for Claude Code: AI crawler access, what AI sees on a page, llms.txt and agent readiness, brand presence (Wikidata, Wikipedia, news, research, communities), speed, schema, Bing, Brave and your own Search Console. Plus skills for audits, llms.txt and robots.txt AI policy.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID (Search Console)
google_client_id.description: Optional. A Desktop-app OAuth client from your Google Cloud project with the Search Console API enabled. Then ask Claude to connect Search Console.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret (Search Console)
google_client_secret.description: The client secret for the Desktop-app client above. Stored in your system keychain.

google_service_account_file.title: Google service account key file (Search Console, alternative)
google_service_account_file.description: Optional alternative to signing in: a service account JSON key whose email is a user on your Search Console property.

bing_api_key.title: Bing Webmaster Tools API key
bing_api_key.description: Optional. Bing Webmaster Tools > Settings > API access. Only sent to Bing.

brave_api_key.title: Brave Search API key
brave_api_key.description: Optional. Enables Brave Search rankings. Free plan at api-dashboard.search.brave.com. Only sent to Brave.

opr_api_key.title: Open PageRank API key
opr_api_key.description: Optional. Adds a 0-10 link-authority score to the authority check. Free at domcop.com/openpagerank.

openalex_api_key.title: OpenAlex API key
openalex_api_key.description: Optional. Your own OpenAlex quota for research citations (openalex.org/settings/api).

psi_api_key.title: PageSpeed Insights API key
psi_api_key.description: Optional. Your own Google PageSpeed Insights quota instead of the shared one.
